knowledge_review.policy: Evaluate relevant external references against local evidence; adoption is optional. Missing source detail and negative transfer remain explicit.
knowledge_review.proposal_output: Add top-level knowledge_assessments: [{knowledge_id, decision: used|considered|rejected|unresolved, rationale, transformed_mechanism, variant_names, nearest_work_difference, falsifier}]. Cover retrieved industry cards; identify the concrete changed mechanism for used cards. This is provenance, not causal proof.
knowledge_review.reflection: Review the latest knowledge-usage.json alongside outcomes; distinguish declared use, executed changes, mechanism evidence and unresolved attribution.

assessments.rationale: Read the original scoped record and retained its population gain, exploratory short/empty regressions, alternatives and limitations.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Select native derivatives on <=16 supplied events and retain inherited half on longer histories.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Adds per-impression derivative routing, not a pairing factorial or independent-seed replication; novelty unverified.
assessments.falsifier: Failure to improve short metrics while retaining population AUC, or incorrect forward/VJP isolation, defeats the declared directional use.

assessments.rationale: Read the original decision, alternatives, limitations and cost/next-action records; inspected the exported legacy source and matched its hash. Latest usage correctly describes a quality-equal transport contrast without stable timing benefit.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Retain the legacy no-row backbone as the common implementation and change only sparse derivative routing.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No further identity-transport optimization or inference-only timing retraining; paired-seed closure remains pending.
assessments.falsifier: Unreported parent training arithmetic/source changes or claiming seed42 as independent-seed evidence invalidate use.

assessments.rationale: Retrieved bounded index reports crossed transfer and recommends paired-seed closure. Preserve this as context; no claim to have re-read its full original record here.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Crossed pairing and its interaction are not tested by the new pair; no closed multi-seed inference.
assessments.falsifier: Presenting this routing contrast as a replication of the pairing-by-gradient interaction would misstate the evidence.

assessments.rationale: Read primary archived mechanism lines240-299 and inspected the adapted baseline source; preserve the original softmax difference.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Inherit local target-aware activation and relevance inputs; no new prediction architecture.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: The new work is derivative routing, while original DIN target relevance is inherited; no exact DIN reproduction or priority claim.
assessments.falsifier: Claiming the original paper specifies the local masked-softmax or proposed derivative gate would be incorrect.

assessments.rationale: Retrieved provenance card warns full-paper verification is incomplete; no new DMR reproduction or detailed mechanism claim is made.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No DMR auxiliary task or field substitution is introduced; candidate inherits the available local category/brand interface.
assessments.falsifier: Attributing a verified DMR mechanism or effect to this routing pair without primary inspection/local controls would be unsupported.

assessments.rationale: Organizer summary only, source pCVR/multi-domain mismatch, no isolated local field-token bottleneck evidence. Joint token expansion would mix capacity and interaction changes while the observed limitation concerns backward allocation.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No token budget, projection or decoding architecture is adopted; preserve external uncertainty.
assessments.falsifier: A future verified local token bottleneck and matched-capacity controls could justify reconsideration; this pair does not refute the external method.

assessments.rationale: Organizer summary only; no measured older/recent incremental-utility split or domain-summary exchange limitation. Adding dual sequence paths/gates would confound the single derivative intervention and increase cost.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No history compression, branch exchange or trainable gate is adopted. A fixed mask-length predicate on the existing product derivative is distinct.
assessments.falsifier: Verified age-stratified complementarity and matched-event/compute controls could warrant reconsideration; current evidence establishes no transfer failure.

latest_knowledge_usage.limits: A declared source-to-code link is provenance, not a causal estimate of knowledge value or a novelty score.
